dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Aug 07 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000qywk](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000qywk) Magnitude 6.0 earthquake at 8.43 depth occurred on Aug 07 2025 31km NW of Silur. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -4.2625 longitude 152.9554. It impacted 24195 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
